Title: Billing Portal GRANT — access and manage billing portal
Preconditions: Billing portal feature is provisioned for the org.
Steps to Reproduce (Manual):
1. Go to Settings > Roles & Permissions (avatar menu → Settings → Roles & Permissions; URL /administration/roles-permissions) > Create Custom Role > start from minimal/blank baseline. (Step 1 is a 'Choose a template' dialog with Skip / Apply; the footer save button on the Create Role page is labelled 'Create'.)
2. Set exactly these toggles: Billing Portal ON. Click Save.
3. Go to Administration > Staff. Assign the custom role to the test user.
4. In a separate browser, log in as the test user.
5. Locate the Billing Portal navigation entry and open it.
6. Access and manage the billing portal.
Expected Result: With Billing Portal ON, the user can access and manage the billing portal.
Actual Result (Observed): EXPECTED: with billingPortalPageAccess granted, Billing Portal is accessible/manageable. ACTUAL: billingPortalPageAccess hydrates ON for Tech, but the staff SPA build contains NO billing-portal route and NO billing-portal API endpoint. Granting the permission leads to no reachable surface = build gap. (Caveat: may exist as a separate external app.)
Reason / Root Cause: build gap: billingPortalPageAccess grants no reachable surface in this build
Spec / Requirement Reference: SV-7388 · Billing Portal (billingPortal) · VIU-39: granting the portal page-access permission hydrates but the staff SPA build exposes no portal route or API — no reachable surface (may be by-design; portals may be separate customer-facing apps)

Title: Manage AP/AR GRANT — Unpaid/Payments/Credits tabs, aging reports, bulk payments
Preconditions: Customers/vendors with unpaid invoices, payments, and credits exist; aging data exists.
Steps to Reproduce (Manual):
1. Go to Settings > Roles & Permissions (avatar menu → Settings → Roles & Permissions; URL /administration/roles-permissions) > Create Custom Role > start from minimal/blank baseline. (Step 1 is a 'Choose a template' dialog with Skip / Apply; the footer save button on the Create Role page is labelled 'Create'.)
2. Set exactly these toggles: View and Manage AP/AR Data ON; Reports ON; Customer/Vendor View ON. Click Save.
3. Go to Administration > Staff. Assign the custom role to the test user.
4. In a separate browser, log in as the test user.
5. Open the Customer and Vendor detail pages.
6. Open Reports and locate AR Aging (Summary/Detail/Collection) and AP Aging (Summary/Detail, AP Unpaid Invoices).
7. From the Unpaid Invoices tab, initiate a bulk payment.
Expected Result: With View and Manage AP/AR Data ON, the Unpaid/Payments/Credits tabs, AP/AR aging reports, and bulk payments are all available.
Actual Result (Observed): seeApArData verified as a front-end-only gate: as Tech, AP/AR data endpoints (e.g. customer-account/payment-methods) returned HTTP 200 with seeApArData both ON and OFF (no 403); the AP/AR list endpoints returned identical results. The Unpaid/Payments/Credits tab & aging-report visibility is front-end only; not observable via API. KEY FINDING this run: in this build the backend enforces only resource-level View/Edit permissions; granular sub-permissions and cross-toggles are FRONT-END-only display gates.
Reason / Root Cause: front-end-only display gate; AP/AR surface visibility not backend-enforced (needs rendered UI)
Spec / Requirement Reference: SV-7388 · View and Manage AP/AR Data (seeApArData) · VIU-38: backend enforces only resource-level View/Edit; this granular sub-permission / cross-toggle / view_mode is a FRONT-END-only display gate, not server-enforced (restriction observable only in the rendered DOM, not via the API)

1. Go to Settings > Roles & Permissions (avatar menu → Settings → Roles & Permissions; URL /administration/roles-permissions) > Create Custom Role > start from minimal/blank baseline. (Step 1 is a 'Choose a template' dialog with Skip / Apply; the footer save button on the Create Role page is labelled 'Create'.)
2. Set exactly these toggles: Work Orders View ON, Pick Parts OFF. Click Save.
3. Go to Administration > Staff. Assign the custom role to the test user.
4. In a separate browser, log in as the test user.
5. Open Work Order WO-PICK-002 and attempt to pick parts from inventory onto the WO line.
Expected Result: With Pick Parts OFF, the user cannot pick parts from inventory onto a WO line.
Actual Result (Observed): woPickParts hydrates for Tech. Backend does NOT enforce it: work-orders/part/perform-request-status-action (action=pick) returns 400 validation (not 403) with only workOrdersView, i.e. the pick gate is front-end only. Confirming the Pick control needs rendered-DOM on a WO with part requests. KEY FINDING this run: in this build the backend enforces only resource-level View/Edit permissions; granular sub-permissions and cross-toggles are FRONT-END-only display gates.
Reason / Root Cause: front-end-only display gate; Pick control presence needs rendered WO DOM
